briefdescription.para: Collection of on the fly FPPassManagers.

detaileddescription.para: These managers manage function passes that are required by module passes.

briefdescription.para: createPrinterPass - Get a module printer pass.
run - Execute all of the passes scheduled for execution.

detaileddescription.para: Execute all of the passes scheduled for execution by invoking runOnModule method.
Keep track of whether any of the passes modifies the module, and if so, return true.

briefdescription.para: Pass Manager itself does not invalidate any analysis info.
Add RequiredPass into list of lower level passes required by pass P.

detaileddescription.para: RequiredPass is run on the fly by Pass Manager when P requests it through getAnalysis interface.

briefdescription.para: Return function pass corresponding to PassInfo PI, that is required by module pass MP.

detaileddescription.para: Instantiate analysis pass, by using its runOnFunction() for function F.

briefdescription.para: getPassName - Return a nice clean name for a pass.

detaileddescription.para: This usually implemented in terms of the name that is registered by one of the Registration templates, but can be overloaded directly.

briefdescription.para: doInitialization - Virtual method overridden by subclasses to do any necessary initialization before any pass is run.
doFinalization - Virtual method overriden by subclasses to do any necessary clean up after all passes have run.
MPPassManager manages ModulePasses and function pass managers.

detaileddescription.para: It batches all Module passes and function pass managers together and sequences them to process one module.
